*Mahantaraduka, Hetuduka* (Patthana 18.22) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Methodologically, the work analyzes the complex system of conditional relations by cross-combining categories of the *Mahantaraduka* (the Great Intermediate Dyad) with those of the *Hetuduka* (the Root Dyad).

 Computational analysis via DharmaNexus demonstrates widespread textual reuse throughout the Abhidhamma literature, identifying 1,417 matching passages across 178 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest textual alignment occurs with its inverse matrix configuration, *Hetuduka, Mahantaraduka* (Patthana 24.6), sharing 105 passages (most notably §8.1–13.1 aligned with §17.1–19.1) [DharmaNexus]. Other major text-sharing counterparts include *Mahantaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 21.13), *Cūḷantaraduka, Hetuduka* (Patthana 18.14), *Hetuduka, Mahantaradukādi* (Patthana 18.7), and *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus records no cross-language matches in Sanskrit, Chinese, or Tibetan corpora [DharmaNexus].
